validation.name: client-tests-invalid-target
validation.resolved_by: client-tests: this package has a binary target, no library

limits: Matched decisions from a retained original-policy prefix, not independent win-rate samples.
The subject cannot start another relocation in any arm; normal range/footing and the original opponent policy continue.
Horizons end at battle end or 20 seconds; damage is capped by remaining health.
A reached goal does not establish tactical benefit; accepted movement can discard a promising aim correction.
Timing is whole-scene desktop measurement, not isolated AI cost or Pi qualification.
